title: Fix Capsule q Drag Palette Seed
description: Dragging Capsule Q from puzzle 3d palette crashes because catalog lacks meshUrl and resolveObjectKindMeshUrl falls back to puzzle3d://palette-seed. Rename to Capsule q and add capsule_q.glb mesh.
summary: Capsule Z drop crashed because mergePaletteObjectFromDrop returned null (no catalog meshUrl) and handleFixtureDrop replaced the scene with the raw palette drag fixture containing puzzle3d://palette-seed. Fixed drop routing via resolvePuzzle3dFixtureDrop, added inferMetabolismMeshUrlForKindName, backfilled 23 catalog meshUrls, guarded MeshBody/ObjectItem against non-loadable URLs. Tests 274/274.
